meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成无真人出镜的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成文字快速做成讲解视频,又不想出镜或拍摄。
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, notes, or a topic into a faceless explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want explainer videos from written text without filming yourself.

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记、话题)做成无真人出镜的讲解视频:画面按场景现做(排版、图形、图表等),并产出分镜板、脚本和渲染好的视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想把文章、笔记或某个话题做成讲解视频(概念拆解、教程、清单等)时触发;若要做网站宣传片,则走 /product-launch-video。

howto.what_en: Turns text (an article, notes or a topic) into a faceless explainer video: visuals are invented per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams, data-viz), producing STORYBOARD.md, SCRIPT.md and a rendered video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want text — an article, notes or a topic — made into an explainer video (concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles). For a promo or tour built from a website, use /product-launch-video.
